CHAPTER.VERS: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: Oh deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
For you are the God of my strength; why have you cast me off? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Oh send out your light and your truth; let them lead me: Let them bring me to your holy hill, And to your tabernacles.
Then I will go to the altar of God, To God my exceeding joy; And on the harp I will praise you, O God, my God.
Why are you cast down, O my soul? And why are you disquieted inside me? Hope in God; for I will yet praise him, My salvation and my God.
